dataset_info.description: Golden Q&A evaluation set for testing factual groundedness and citation accuracy.

golden_qa.question: How long is the initial term of the TechHub operation agreement?
golden_qa.expected_answer: The agreement runs for three (3) years from the Commencement Date.

golden_qa.question: What percentage of workspace revenue must TechHub remit to the university each month?
golden_qa.expected_answer: TechHub must remit twenty-five percent (25%) of workspace revenue earned each calendar month.

golden_qa.question: How many days' written notice is required for a party to terminate the TechHub agreement without cause?
golden_qa.expected_answer: Not less than ninety (90) days' written notice is required.

golden_qa.question: How many days does TechHub have to remove its installed equipment after termination or expiry of the agreement?
golden_qa.expected_answer: TechHub has sixty (60) days to remove all installed equipment.

golden_qa.question: Under what law is the TechHub agreement governed?
golden_qa.expected_answer: The agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

golden_qa.question: How much advance written notice must the Faculty give TechHub for planned maintenance or closures?
golden_qa.expected_answer: The Faculty must communicate planned maintenance or closures affecting the premises in writing at least fourteen (14) days in advance.

golden_qa.question: How many months' prior written notice must the University give if it wants to buy out TechHub's operation?
golden_qa.expected_answer: The University must give not less than six (6) months' prior written notice of its intention to take over the operation.

golden_qa.question: Under the TechHub agreement, how often must the Parties meet to review operations?
golden_qa.expected_answer: The Parties shall meet not less than once every six (6) months to review operations.

golden_qa.question: What data protection regulation must TechHub comply with under the agreement?
golden_qa.expected_answer: TechHub must comply fully with the Nigeria Data Protection Regulation 2019 (NDPR) and any successor legislation.

golden_qa.question: What is the length of the mandatory probationary period in the employment agreement?
golden_qa.expected_answer: The probationary period is three months.

golden_qa.question: What hourly rate will the Employer pay the Employee under the agreement?
golden_qa.expected_answer: The Employer will pay the Employee at a rate of $26.00 per hour.

golden_qa.question: What overtime rate applies if the Employee works extra hours?
golden_qa.expected_answer: The Employee is paid at 1.5 (one and a half) times their normal compensation for extra time worked.

golden_qa.question: How much notice must the Employer give before changing employee benefits?
golden_qa.expected_answer: The Employer must give 60 days written notice of any changes to benefits.

golden_qa.question: What is the Employee's job title under this agreement?
golden_qa.expected_answer: The Employee is employed as a Sales Representative.

golden_qa.question: On what date does the Employee's employment commence under this agreement?
golden_qa.expected_answer: The Employee's employment commences on September 24th, 2006.

negative_test_cases.question: What is TechHub's policy on remote work stipends for its staff?
negative_test_cases.reason: The TechHub agreement covers hub operations and revenue share; it does not address staff remote-work stipends.

negative_test_cases.question: What health insurance benefits does the Employee receive under the employment agreement?
negative_test_cases.reason: The sample employment agreement text provided does not specify health insurance benefits; it only mentions unspecified benefits 'reflected in current revisions of the Employer's booklets and manuals.'

negative_test_cases.question: How many square meters is the TechHub premises at the Faculty of Law?
negative_test_cases.reason: Schedule A, which would contain this figure, is left blank/unfilled in the sample agreement.

negative_test_cases.question: What is the Employee's job title in the TechHub agreement?
negative_test_cases.reason: The TechHub agreement is a hub operating agreement between a university faculty and a company; it contains no employee job title, which only exists in the separate employment agreement document.
